tools.name: diagnose_tool_failure
tools.description: Classify a failed MCP/API tool call and recommend bounded next actions. Offline deterministic analysis. Does NOT retry, contact a service, or store the supplied error text.

tools.name: validate_tool_arguments
tools.description: Check supplied tool arguments against a constrained subset of JSON Schema (type, required, properties, additionalProperties, enum, const, numeric/string bounds, arrays). Returns paths and errors, no network access or storage. NOT full JSON Schema validation.

tools.name: ecosystem_catalog
tools.description: Discover useful independent agent-native tools from this same project and their MCP connection URLs. No request to another service, referrals only when relevant.
